annotation.title_clean: UL 3300: Safety Requirements for Service, Communication, Information, Education and Entertainment (SCIEE) Robots
annotation.title_en: UL 3300: Safety Requirements for Service, Communication, Information, Education and Entertainment (SCIEE) Robots
annotation.summary_en: UL 3300 catalogue page for the safety standard for service, communication, information, education and entertainment (SCIEE) robots, including consumer-proximate ones. It supplements UL 62368-1 and UL 60335-1 with requirements for mobility and manipulation hazards, lists exclusions, revision changes (including AI in safety functions), and referenced standards such as UL 3115.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes safety requirements for SCIEE robots used by or near consumers, indoors and outdoors.
Supplements UL 62368-1 and UL 60335-1 for mobility and uncontained manipulation hazards.
Excludes industrial, medical, agricultural, food preparation, hazardous-location, road transport and toy robots.
Revision adds tests for obstacles, stability, moisture, remote controllers and robots using AI in safety functions.
References UL 3115 (Outline of Investigation for Safety of AI-Based Products) and aligns with ISO 18646-2.
